function: Time-domain MIMO channel prediction: forecasts NL future CSI frames from NP past estimated frames, using an all-linear encoder-only Transformer with a time-aware MLP replacing attention (p. 3-4).
system: TDD MIMO with T = 4 transmit and R = 2 receive antennas at 28 GHz; no RIS; measured V2X CSI used for fine-tuning (p. 2, 7, 12).
method: Encoder-only Transformer with time-aware MLP replacing attention; supervised, weighted MSE loss, noise augmentation; pretrained on simulation, fine-tuned on measured CSI (p. 4-8, 12).
data_channel: Simulated: MATLAB 5G Toolbox CDL-B (3GPP 38.901) channels, 11,000 frames per speed and delay spread, SNR 0-20 dB. Measured: vehicle-to-roadside-unit V2X CSI (p. 7, 12).
test_conditions: Simulated: train on first 10,000 frames, test on last 1,000 per speed (SNR 0-20 dB). Measured: fine-tune on 750 samples, test on 50 from other segments (p. 7, 12).
baselines: Learned: Transformer, GRU, LSTM. Non-learned: outdated CSI and MMSE channel estimation (reference curves in Figs. 8-11, 15) (p. 8-9).
metrics: Channel prediction MSE (dB) per frame and averaged, MRT beamforming channel capacity (bit/s/Hz), inference speed (samples/s) (p. 8-11).
complexity: Complexity orders for LSTM, GRU, Transformer, LinFormer (Eq. 22, Table I); 14.8M parameters (Table II); inference within 2 ms on GTX 1050 Ti (p. 7, 11-12).
q1_support: p. 7: "Standardized clustered delay line (CDL) model [38] for cellular communications is used in our simulation experiments" ([38] is 3GPP 38.901, p. 14); p. 7: "based on the CDL-B model"; p. 12: measured V2X CSI
q2_support: p. 12: "We utilized 750 measured CSI training samples to fine-tune our pre-trained model, which was initially trained on a substantial amount of simulated data"
q3_support: p. 8: "a comparative analysis of the proposed LinFormer, Transformer, GRU and LSTM models in terms of channel prediction MSE"; p. 9: "surpasses the immediate MMSE channel estimation for future time steps"
q4_support: p. 7: "Proposition 3: The computational complexity of the proposed LinFormer is" 2NencNP^2 d + 2NencNP d^2 + 2NLRT d + NPNL d; p. 11: "completes its predictions within 2 ms"
q5_support: p. 12: "we propose to fine-tune [43] all models using measured CSI"; fine-tuning and testing use measured V2X data. No code or data link or DOI is given anywhere, so this rests only on the measured-data clause.
notes: Included, area 2 (channel prediction); R = 2 and T = 4, so the single-antenna exclusion does not apply. q1: experiments use the 5G Toolbox CDL-B profile, although the system model of p. 3 writes a Saleh-Valenzuela channel in Eq. (4). q3: the outdated-CSI curve appears only in figure legends (Figs. 8, 10, 11, 15) and is not named in the text, whereas MMSE estimation is named on p. 9; learned baselines are standard architectures applied to the same problem. q5: no release of code or data is stated and the measured campaign is from an earlier work [42] (p. 11-12); marked met only because the criterion lists training and testing on measured data, so the reviewer should confirm that reading.
